title: Study plan *prompt*
sahi: Make a [4-week] study plan for [SSC CGL]. I can study [2 hours] a day. Split it by topic and add a weekly revision day.

scenes.voice: Galat versus sahi prompt. Study plan edition.
scenes.voice_tts: Ghalat versus sahi prompt. Study plan edition.

scenes.voice: Most people type: make me a study plan.
The AI has no idea about your exam, your time, or your deadline. So you get a generic plan.
Instead, give it your exam, the number of weeks, and your daily hours. Ask for topics split by week, plus a revision day.
More details in, a better plan out.
